segments.text:
V. 25.
But Abraham ſaid, Son—According to the Fleſh. Is it not worthy of Obſervation, that Abraham will not revile even a damned Soul? Shall living Men revile one another? Thou in thy life-time receivedſt thy good things—Thou didſt chuſe and accept of worldly Things as thy Good, thy Happineſs. And can any be at a Loſs to know why he was in Torments? This damnable Idolatry, had there been Nothing more, was enough to ſink him to the nethermoſt Hell.
